t: Alerts & settings menu: Calls, reminders and notifications.
ShankhNaad rings for calls, reminds you of meetings and work, and can show desktop notifications.
In this video, you will learn how to answer or decline a call, decline with a message, and turn on desktop alerts.
When someone calls, a ringing card appears at the bottom right.
Press Accept to join with video.
Decline ends the ringing. The bell silences it but keeps the card.
The message button declines with a quick reply, which is also posted in your chat with the caller.
Before a meeting starts, ShankhNaad reminds you, with a Join button. Stand-ups, approvals and role requests remind you too.
If the bell shows in the left menu, press it and allow notifications, so calls ring even when ShankhNaad is in the background.
For the best experience, install the desktop app from your profile menu.
That completes the Calls, reminders and notifications page.
